section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种生物基因工程的生物育苗箱，包括主体，所述主体由培养箱、水箱、养料箱、药箱和遮挡组组成，所述水箱位于培养箱顶部，所述培养箱内部设有推动板和灌溉板，所述推动板上设有土壤，所述灌溉板位于土壤顶部，所述水箱底部设有水管，所述水管位于培养箱两侧并连接灌溉板，所述土壤两侧设有固定孔，所述养料箱底部设有导料管且导料管连接固定孔，所述药箱底部设有导药管且导药管连接灌溉板，所述遮挡组位于培养箱前面，所述遮挡组包括挡板、固定轴承、连接杆、转动齿轮和齿条。本实用新型实现对生物苗进行培养，有效的保证生物苗正常的生长便于观测，生物基因工程的生物育苗箱具有结构简单、使用方便、简洁、使用效果好的优点。

The utility model discloses a biological seedling raising box of biological genetic engineering, comprising a main body, the main part comprises incubator, water tank, nourishment case, medical kit and shelters from the group, the water tank is located the incubator top, incubator inside is equipped with slurcam and irrigation plate, be equipped with soil on the slurcam, irrigation plate is located the soil top, the water tank bottom is equipped with the water pipe, the water pipe is located the incubator both sides and connects irrigation plate, the soil both sides are equipped with the fixed orifices, nourishment bottom of the case portion is equipped with passage and passage connection fixed orifices, the medical kit bottom is equipped with leads the pencil and connect irrigation plate, it is preceding to shelter from the group position in the incubator, it includes baffle, fixing bearing, connecting rod, rolling gear and rack to shelter from the group. The utility model discloses the realization is cultivateed biological seedling, and the normal growth of effectual biological seedling of assurance is convenient for observe, and biological gene engineering's biological seedling raising box has simple structure, convenient to use, succinct, excellent in use effect's advantage.

Biological seedling raising box for biological gene engineeringTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a biological genetic engineering field specifically is a biological seedling raising box of biological genetic engineering.

Background

The seedling raising mode is that the special container is used to raise the seedling of crop, fruit tree, flower and forest. The container is filled with nutrient-rich culture soil and other matrixes, and the seedlings are usually cultured in protective facilities such as plastic greenhouses, greenhouses and the like, so that the seedlings can grow and develop under better nutrient and environmental conditions. The seedlings are planted along with rhizosphere soil mass, the root system is less damaged in the seedling lifting and planting process, the survival rate is high, the seedling reviving period is short, the emergence is fast, the growth is vigorous, and the method is particularly suitable for crops or trees which are not resistant to transplantation.

In the prior art, when the biological seedlings are cultured, the nutrients and water content of the biological seedlings need to be ensured to be sufficient, and meanwhile, the illumination receiving time of the biological seedlings in an incubator needs to be ensured.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a biological seedling raising box of biological genetic engineering to solve the problem that proposes among the above-mentioned background art.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: a biological seedling raising box for biological genetic engineering comprises a main body, wherein the main body consists of an incubator, a water tank, a nutrient box, a medicine box and a shielding group, the water tank is positioned at the top of the incubator, a push plate and an irrigation plate are arranged inside the incubator, soil is arranged on the push plate, the irrigation plate is positioned at the top of the soil, a water pipe is arranged at the bottom of the water tank, the water pipe is positioned at two sides of the incubator and is connected with the irrigation plate, fixing holes are formed at two sides of the soil, a material guide pipe and a material guide pipe connecting fixing hole are arranged at the bottom of the nutrient box, a medicine guide pipe and a medicine guide pipe connecting irrigation plate are arranged at the bottom of the medicine box, the shielding group is positioned in front of the incubator and comprises a baffle, a fixing bearing, a connecting rod, a rotating gear and a rack, a fixing rod is arranged at the bottom of the rotating gear, the fixing bearing is positioned at the bottom of the baffle and is connected with the baffle at the top of the baffle, the connecting rod is provided with a fixed gear, and the rack is connected with the fixed gear and the rotating gear.

Preferably, a fertilizer valve is arranged at the joint of the feed box and the material guide pipe.

Preferably, a medicine valve is arranged at the joint of the medicine box and the medicine guide pipe.

Preferably, the irrigation plate is provided with irrigation holes.

Preferably, the baffle is provided with a vent hole.

Preferably, a water valve is arranged at the joint of the water tank and the water pipe.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that:

1. the utility model discloses a water tank, medical kit and nourishment case, guaranteed the sufficiency of biological seedling nutrient, the detection of being convenient for, through putting biological seedling into the incubator at first, then through with water piping connection irrigation plate for the water tank, the medical kit passes through the fixed orifices on the guide tube connection soil of medicine guide union coupling irrigation plate and nourishment case, irrigate, fertilize and spread the medicine to biological seedling, only need will open the water valve of control water pipe, the fertilizer valve of control medicine guide tube and the fertilizer valve of guide tube, the healthy growth of biological seedling has effectively been guaranteed, the detection of being convenient for;

2. the utility model discloses an installation shelters from the group, and the effectual biological seedling of having guaranteed accepts the sunlight and shines and the air suction, at first through sheltering from the group mount at the incubator preceding. Air helps biological seedling oxygen uptake in getting into the incubator through the air vent on the baffle, when needs carry out the photosynthesis to biological seedling, only need make the fixed gear follow the rotation through the effect of rotating the gear through the rack, the baffle rotates through fixing bearing, in the sunlight shines the access device, the effectual growth environment of guaranteeing biological seedling.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments. Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative work belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1-4, the present invention provides a technical solution: the utility model provides a biological seedling raising box of biological genetic engineering, includes main part 1, main part 1 comprises incubator 2, water tank 3, nourishment case 4, medical kit 5 and shelters from group 6, water tank 3 is located incubator 2 top, incubator 2 is inside to be equipped with slurcam 21 and irrigation plate 23, be equipped with soil 22 on the slurcam 21, irrigation plate 23 is located soil 22 top, water tank 3 bottom is equipped with water pipe 31, water pipe 31 is located incubator 2 both sides and connects irrigation plate 23, soil 22 both sides are equipped with fixed orifices 221, nourishment case 4 bottom is equipped with passage 41 and passage 41 connects fixed orifices 221, medical kit 5 bottom is equipped with medicine guide pipe 51 and connects irrigation plate 23, it is preceding to shelter from group 6 to be located incubator 2, it includes baffle 61, fixing bearing 62, connecting rod 63, rotating gear 64 and rack 65 to shelter from group 6, the fixed rod 641 is disposed at the bottom of the rotating gear 64, the fixed bearing 62 is disposed at the bottom of the baffle 61 and connected to the baffle, the connecting rod 63 is disposed at the top of the baffle 61 and connected to the baffle 61, the fixed gear 631 is disposed on the connecting rod 63, and the rack 65 connects the fixed gear 631 and the rotating gear 64.

A fertilizer valve 42 is arranged at the joint of the nutrient box 4 and the material guide pipe 41, and can control nutrients to biological seedlings;

a medicine valve 52 is arranged at the joint of the medicine box 5 and the medicine guide pipe 51, and can control the application of the biological seedlings;

the irrigation plate 23 is provided with irrigation holes 231, so that water can flow out from the irrigation holes to irrigate the biological seedlings;

the baffle 61 is provided with a vent hole 611 which can ventilate the device;

a water valve 311 is arranged at the joint of the water tank 3 and the water pipe 31, and can control the water inflow pipe 31 of the water source to enter the irrigation plate 23.

The working principle is as follows: when the biological seedling raising box of the biological gene engineering is used, firstly, because the device belongs to a flexible device, some details need to be noticed in the operation, firstly, the pushing plate 21 is pulled out from the culture box 2, then biological seedlings are planted on the soil 22, then the pushing plate 21 is pushed into the culture box 2, when the biological seedlings need to be watered, only the water valve 311 needs to be rotated, water in the water tank 3 enters the water pipe 31 and flows into the irrigation plate 23, flows out from the irrigation hole 231, and irrigates the biological seedlings, when the biological seedlings are fertilized, only the fertilizer needs to be poured into the nutrient box 4, the fertilizer enters the fixed hole 221 on the soil 22 through the guide pipe 41 by rotating the fertilizer valve 42, the fertilizer is quickly melted, the biological seedlings are helped to be absorbed, when the biological seedlings are fertilized, only the medicine needs to be poured into the medicine box 5, and by rotating the medicine valve 52, the medicine flows into irrigation plate 23 through medicine guide tube 51, drenches the biological seedling through irrigation hole 231, admits air through air vent 611 on baffle 61 and helps guaranteeing biological seedling's aerobic respiration, makes fixed gear 631 follow the rotation through the effect of rack 65 through rotating rotary gear 64, and baffle 61 rotates through fixed bearing 62, and in the sunlight irradiation admission device, the operation ended.
